about.metaDescription: Learn more about Artur Sobolewski — full stack web developer: skills, technologies and the way I work.
about.title: A developer who cares about the whole product
about.bio1: I'm Artur, a full stack web developer with about 5 years of experience. I enjoy working across the entire stack — from modelling data and designing APIs to polishing the last details of the user interface.
about.bio2: I believe good software is simple to use and simple to change. That is why I focus on clean, typed code, sensible architecture and automated testing and deployment.
about.bioAi: In my day-to-day work I use Claude Code, an AI coding assistant. It handles repetitive tasks and speeds up prototyping, so I can spend more time on architecture and product details — and every change still goes through my review.
about.bio3: I work with companies and individuals on websites, web applications and internal tools, and I am happy to take a project from the first idea all the way to production.

hobby.title: Patience, focus, precision
hobby.text: When I'm away from the keyboard, you'll often find me at the archery range with a compound bow. Archery and programming have more in common than it seems — both reward patience, consistency and attention to the smallest details.
